text:
Right, where do I even begin? I visited this fast food restaurant at 2:30am after an incredible night out expecting to satisfy my built up hunger, however the staff stopped me from doing so, therefore ruining my night.

I ordered 3 hamburgers, 2 chicken mayos + a meal at 2:30 and the ticket machine wasn’t working but I knew my number. I waited over an hour and a half and spoke to almost every staff member available and they just didn’t care about my order not having been called out. They all promised me that they would sort it out and would then just disappear back into the kitchen and do whatever they do back there because they definitely weren’t focusing on attending their customers.

This is appalling behaviour from a prestigious establishment like McDonald’s and I have to say that I will never ever ever be going back again, and I’ll make sure word spreads across generations.

I literally lost €15 because they refused to give me my order and was refused a refund for my order. This is an absolutely robbery
author: Benjamin Kosza

text: I must say i was very hungry and looking forward to a beautiful, tasty mcdonald’s , i ordered and waited a long tretcherous  wait for my food while i watched all the people who ordered after me get theirs first , after that long wait i obviously assumed they made my food fresh, little did i know. i opened my big mac to take the gerkins out as per usual when i seen a nut load of big mac special sauce on it morning on the top but the middle and bottom, i got curios and looked for my lettuce and there was none. soon after this disappointment my friend joined me with her mccrispy just to find out there was only mayonnaise in it and no lettuce ,i am out raged we also paid for curry sauce (the sweet one to be exact) and they did not serve it. my friend is here scarping ketchup off the napkin so she dosent eat dry selects. i am beyond disappointed im requesting for this establishment to be shut ammeditlry or give me a refund , kind but not kind regards
author: Lauren Cleary

text:
Worst McDonald's experience ever. Waited and waited - the screens had numbers far from mine. I was number 002 and I ordered 16:22 and still waiting after 25  minutes and the staff was calling out numbers like 45-65. My number was not on the screen so I was confused. My order was simple Happy meal, nothing difficult, fries, burger and Sprite. This is crazy. The staff did not even want to talk to me when I asked about my order, just looked at me and turned away. Yes, I know it is December however this is McDonalds and they should handle a little traffic. Othe People where returning items because they where wrongly made or wrong items, they ordered chicken nuggets and got hamburgers and so on. Go to a another place.
If you have rush hour at least have the screen working correctly and showing when orders are ready or being made.
author: Björn Ólafsson

text: Hell on earth...a pit of potential Covid waiting to happen. Does anyone remember what a microphone was or a loudspeaker headpiece? Can't you give your staff that at the collection counters? Numbers are all over the place with no rhyme or reason that I can figure out. Orders just get forgotten...god help anyone that's deaf or has a hearing/visual disability cause you would never hear your number, or have a chance to get up. No manager on duty available...saw a woman wait 20 mins for a manager cause her 5 orders were wrong and she just got free drinks. Honestly I saw the defeat in her eyes cause it's like talking to robots that only got like half the updated software installed. Everybody is trained in one singular job or motion and that's it. If you do have to go...wear a mask.
author: Audrey Dalton

text:
Absolutely ashamed to be from Dublin..To witness the chaos with service, the dirt of the floors,seating areas where people are to eat 😕 😞 the gang of young people running wild and nobody saying or doing anything to remove them...
The worker whom was ment to be working was to busy looking into tin air.. The cloth use for wiping the table,I'd say had 100% bacteria all over it and hadn't been changed in days..
My husband used the toilets he said where Absolutely disgusting...as it was NFL weekend,we over heard American visitors complaining about how dirty the toilets and whole off McDonald's was ..I will never be back and I will inform family,friends not to touch the place,we could witness anymore so we left...
author: Sinead Tilley

text:
I was shocked and very upset in McDonalds Grafton Street today. I ordered a large laté and was given a half filled cup with a disgusting jelly,  sticky type substance on top of the coffee inside the cup.  Also there were small cloth like hairs inside the cup, like fabric.

It was disgusting.  I went back to the staff who gave it to me and showed her and she said that’s ok and the jelly sticky substance was a topping, it definitely was not and I did not ask for a topping either way.

My coffee was replaced but this is not right, you need to be careful what is being served and its condition.
author: Tsering Dolma

text: You stole from the wrong person my friends. and to ask me for proof of payment after you can't be bothered to sort the ticket machine out via a bank statement that is a huge mistake when it comes to dgp rules. Your be hearing from my solicitor and plz be sweet and keep that video footage. They going to want me to show the courts that I was showing you my statements twice as proof I paid from my phone. Then refuse to give me my money back oh you messed up big time.
author: Chris Wyatt

text: Very bad service, took me 40 minutes for the food to arrive and the manager who wouldn’t tell me her name was shouting at me. I asked for her name 3 times and she wouldn’t tell me. I didn’t get my full order and went back to ask her for my food and she shouted. By the time she gave me my food the chips were cold and everything tasted cold. Horrible service I hope I find the managers name on duty.
author: Matei Domsa

text: Just waited an hour and 10 minutes for my food. Asked repeatedly about it, showed proof of purchase and described my order. The manager said he would look into it but I never got my order OF SOME CHICKEN NUGGETS. I just decided to leave because at that stage I wasn’t even hungry anymore. Literally the worst McDonald’s experience ever. Opposite of fast food
author: Grace Quinlan

text: Had breakfast here. Slow service given how few people there were. They didn't give us a spoon either so we had to go back. The toast had bacon but it was supposed to be just a cheese one. Some foreign employees with such thick accent you can barely understand the order number they just announced.
author: G. S.

text: Dreadful place. Way too busy. One of the cleaning staff (same name as the latest queen of England) verbally abused me because I accidentally spilt some juice on the floor. She engaged with another customer who also gave out to me.  I complained but imagine it's a waste if time. Maybe not.
author: Brian Reilly

text:
Tonight, 21 september, h 3 am, we got served by who looked like the manager.
The service was really bad: the fries were half the container, the nuggets 2 less, no sauces and one burger was thrown without the wrap inside the bag
We spent 30 euro, this is totally unacceptable
author: Laura Canu

text:
They claim they are open 24 hrs. However when I and my distinguished company arrived looking for sustenance at midnight they stated that they were closed. This seems paradoxical to me and requires urgent attention from management in my
opinion.

text: Ordered €13 worth of food and girl just said "you're the only one in the building" sarcasticallly when I didn't get my order. Never ended up getting my order. Waste of money and one hour of my time at 2am.

text: There seems to be water damage in the first floor ceiling and mold really close to the foods.  Despite that the process of ordering was pretty quick even with long queues.

text: Slow service compared to other to other locations I've visited. Once I finally got my food fries were stale and flavourless. Very disappointing visit.

text: Terrible service, I pay and they didn’t give my order, the machine doesn’t print your receipt. Never again in this McDonalds (-1 Star)

text: This is an awful place. They always treat delivery guys very bad. I will never recommend this place!!
